[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Portland, Oregon: Famous for food trucks, craft beer, and coffee culture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Gatlinburg, Tennessee: Offers outdoor adventures, theme parks, and a lively downtown area.
